title: WAF to Amazon CloudFront to Amazon S3
description: AWA WAF to CloudFront to S3

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This sample project demonstrates how can you deploy a MKDOCS site to S3 with CloudFront.
CloudFront executes a function when receiving a request from the viewer and appends index.html to each request for proper routing.
S3 hosts the HTML files generated from the MKDOCS.

testing.headline: Testing
text: You can test the solution by accessing the CloudFront distribution domain using a web browser.
